extracted.name: Ham Rolls
extracted.description: A tray of these mouth-watering ham roll appetizers is sure to put a smile on everyone's face at your next party.
instruction_lines: Lay the ham slices on a flat surface and spread with cream cheese. Place one green onion on each ham slice. Roll the ham slices tightly. Cut into bite sized pieces and serve.
